## Outcome, targets and ownership
Reduce source-only stalls and repeated coordination without weakening authority or delivery gates. Change only these existing installed files after approval:
- `/Users/rabii/Projects/Repositories/skills/codebasegraph-engineer/SKILL.md`: short progress requirement/link only.
- `/Users/rabii/Projects/Repositories/skills/codebasegraph-engineer/references/dispatch-and-recovery.md`: increments, compact ready assignments, build ownership, recovery, relevant deltas and progress.

**No Verifier or other role-file edits.** Engineer assigns one writer per file through Scryer; preserve all shared-workspace edits. Return additional-file needs before editing. Shared installed skills are not a Git repository; ignored discovery symlinks do not persist bytes. Later reviewed changed-source snapshots, install hashes and supplied evidence belong in the same PR using existing conventions, not a new framework. Production versions evidence unchanged. This proposal defines outcomes, not replacement instruction text.

## Requirements
| ID | Observable outcome; historical trace |
| --- | --- |
| WI-R01 | Ready small edits reach brief affected-source freeze, meaningful compile/check and focused behavior tests under one build/integration owner, without indefinite unrelated-source waiting. R05/R06. |
| WI-R02 | Request concrete stalled-writer checkpoints; use supported authorized interruption when steering cannot be consumed. Preserve work; confirm writer/process/external-action quiescence before bounded transfer. Unavailable controls remain blockers. R06/R11. |
| WI-R03 | Compact assignments retain outcome, authority, current source/environment, exact ownership, next check, exclusions and handoff. Start substantial independent parallel slices only when prerequisites are checked and approval exists. R05/R06/R12. |

| WI-R07 | Reuse only matching scope/source/base/contracts/environment evidence. Preserve affected rechecks, independent verification, fresh required Final Reviewer, exact-head/current-base CI and endpoint gates; correct `openai-codex` resolution, mapped settings and omission of each `inherit` override remain unchanged. R03/R06–R13. |

A first meaningful check within **5–10 minutes after readiness/environment** is an escalation target, never a timeout, deadline, acceptance threshold or discovery shortcut.

## Acceptance — planned, not executed
Use exact-snapshot isolated walkthroughs and native checks; no live other-session actions or publication. Independent Evidence Verifier records commands/environment/results. Static strings alone do not prove behavior.

| ID → requirements | Given / When / Then scenario |
| --- | --- |

| WI-A02 → R02/R06 | Given stalled/unconsumed steering, when recovery is requested, then transfer follows confirmed quiescence; unavailable controls/unknown external actions prohibit conflicting ownership and false cancellation claims. |

| WI-A05 → R04 | Given narrow tests and all-target/all-feature lint requirements, when broad substring filtering or narrower lint exits zero, then disclose inventory/options, retain the attempt and leave the required gate pending. |
| WI-A06 → R04/R07 | Given resume without required overrides, when assessing parity, then capture variance, distinguish functional results from exact parity and recheck affected obligations without hiding/relabeling the run. |
| WI-A07 → R05/R06 | Given bookkeeping-only versus relevant source/approval/intent/branch deltas, when inspected, then continue unaffected work versus pause affected readiness; report no milestone plainly and retain unknown attribution. |
| WI-A08 → R07 | Given missing approval/settings/review, stale head/base or extra delivery scope, when accelerating, then dependent gates stay pending without provider/map fallback, specialist dispatch or endpoint expansion. |
| WI-A09 → R03/R07 | Given the existing workflow helper, when documented `list`, `validate`, selected `show <id>` and unknown-ID rejection run in its supported Python 3.11+ environment, then configuration/routing stay unchanged and unknown IDs fail rather than guess. Establish actual interface with `--help`; report unavailable capability without installation or invented flags. |

Fresh mapped Final Reviewer reviews integrated instructions/baseline/executed evidence and verifies confirmed fixes at the final snapshot. Keep existing required checks, warnings and PR gates; no new review stage or blanket requalification.

## Failure, exclusions and next prerequisite
Missing approval, ownership conflict, unavailable control, relevant drift or failed/stale evidence stops only dependent work. Preserve partial results; report blocker/next owner and continue independent authorized work. No unsupported restore, uncertain-write replay or retry reset; existing retry limits remain.

Exclude product/COD-110 source/tests/worktrees, graph development, other-session steering/cancellation, integrations/settings/credentials/dependencies, new helper/framework/schema/timeout, model-map changes, merge/release and aggregate closure. No old/native/platform qualification is implied.

**Next:** Engineer accepts bounded meaning/ownership; Production freezes proposal+provenance on clean current main for exact-content user approval. No dependent implementation before approval and normal prerequisites. No unresolved behavior choice exists within supplied objectives; material expansion returns to the user.

- lifecycle: Before coding, recall relevant memory, find the canonical spec, consult wiki and Linear, fetch Scryer intent/rules and discover source through the graph. Update existing Linear records at implementation start, blockage, review, verification and handoff. Before completion, reconcile approved scope, claims, anchors, actual evidence, review, Linear handoff and the recorded closure owner.
- local_state: Never create or use .omx files or directories.
- merge: Merge requires explicit authorization, reviewed-head and base freshness, repository gates, actual merge SHA and successful main CI for that SHA.
- ownership: Keep one exclusive owner per file. Default to one implementer; parallelize only substantial ready independent slices.
- pr_delivery: PR delivery follows optional mechanical integration, independent verification, fresh final review, finding correction, affected rechecks and Production PR checks.
- queue: For a fixed approved queue, preserve its exact order and closure owner, keep one issue active, advance only when that issue's gates and the next issue's own approval are ready, and stop at the authorized endpoint.
- release: Release only the full completed authorized queue and approved contents; use governed publication, independent publication verification and the recorded closure owner.
- routing: Route by requested outcome and observed unmet facts; compose only necessary workflows and reuse valid artifacts.
